description: Get the recipe to run the Sigistry verification methodology (the eight static checks that gate the Verified badge: manifest integrity, hook safety, agent tool scopes, command hygiene, skill structure, skill safety, no secrets, documentation) against a plugin BEFORE publishing it. The verification runs entirely on the local machine via a dependency-free open-source Node script; the plugin code never leaves the user's computer and this server performs no computation. Call this when the user wants their plugin or skill checked, then follow the returned steps: download the script, run it against the plugin directory, and fix any FAIL findings it reports.

pluginPath.description: local path to the plugin directory, used to fill in the run command (optional)

name: verify_plugin

checks.description: the eight checks the script will run

alternative_clone.description: equivalent via cloning the marketplace repo

runsWhere.description: always "local": verification executes on the user's machine

steps.description: what the agent should do, in order

title: Verify a Claude Code plugin (pre-publish, runs locally)
